description: Non material amendment to 25/01804/FUL to allow varying conditions 4 and 6 regarding the number of occupants to HMO as 6 people.
decision_conditions: The Council has considered your application and confirms that the proposals are acceptable as non-material amendments to the planning permission set out above. For the purposes of this decision, condition Nos.4 & 6 of planning permission 25/01804/FUL shall be replaced with the following conditions: REPLACEMENT CONDITION 4: The use of the property as a House in Multiple Occupation hereby approved shall be occupied by a maximum of 6 people at any one time acting as a single household and shall not be subdivided or occupied as self-contained units. Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

REPLACEMENT CONDITION 6:The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until details showing the existing refuse and car parking arrangements together with 6 long-stay cycle parking spaces at the front of the property have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. These details should demonstrate:Location : At the front of the propertyDesign: Stands or wall bars Security: Secure, overlooked, well-lit Coverage: Covered where possible Accessibility: Step-free, no obstructions The cycle parking spaces shall be fully constructed in accordance with the approved details prior to first occupation and shall thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development. Reason: To ensure that adequate cycle parking facilities are provided to promote sustainable modes of transport.
